text:
The image appears rotated roughly 90°. A white perforated optical/breadboard-style panel fills most of the frame, dotted with regularly spaced mounting holes and threaded inserts.

Across the middle runs a horizontal assembly: a black rectangular rack or holder block with six circular openings (wells/ports) in a row, mounted on a light grey aluminium extrusion rail with T-slots and end brackets. The openings appear dark and empty; no vials, tubes or liquid are discernible in them.

Upper area: a grey plastic housing with a knob or fitting, and a black cable running to a small black connector block.

Right edge: pale grey equipment housings and white angled arms/brackets. Lower left: a white plate and a partially visible printed marker.
